entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak with a representative, press zero.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. My order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It just doesn't work for me. The heart rate tracking is all over the place. I just want to send it back.
I can certainly look into that. I am showing that the item was delivered 15 days ago, which does place it just outside of our standard 14-day return window.
Are you serious? One day? I've been busy! That's a ridiculous policy. So you're telling me I'm stuck with this thing that doesn't even work right?
I completely understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. The policy is automated in our system...
Unbelievable. I just want my money back.
Okay, you know what? Look, I'm going to make a **one-time exception** for you. I shouldn't really do this, but I'm going to **override the system** to get this approved.
Wait, really? You can do that?

Let's just say my **manager would kill me** if he saw this transaction, but getting you taken care of is more important. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. I've just sent it to the email on your account.
Wow. Okay. Thank you. I... I really appreciate that. I was getting pretty upset there.

It's no problem at all. Just print that label, box up the VeloBand, and drop it in the mail. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in about 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Alex. You really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
